record.paper_title: Structural results on circular-arc graphs and circle graphs: A survey and the main open problems
record.original_question: Find a forbidden induced subgraph characterization for normal circular-arc graphs. A circular-arc graph is an intersection graph of open arcs on a circle, and it is normal when it has a circular-arc model in which no two arcs together cover the whole circle. The desired result should specify exactly which induced subgraphs are forbidden for a graph to admit such a normal circular-arc representation.

evidence.quote: Problem 4. Find a characterization by forbidden induced subgraphs for normal circular-arc graphs.
The characterization of normal circular-arc graphs by minimal forbidden induced subgraphs is still open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A circular-arc graph is the intersection graph of a family of open arcs on a circle; such a family is called a circular-arc model of the graph. A circular-arc graph is called normal if it admits a circular-arc model in which no two arcs together cover the entire circle (equivalently, every pair of arcs has a point of the circle not contained in either).

Problem. Determine the complete list of minimal forbidden induced subgraphs for the class of normal circular-arc graphs. That is, characterize the graphs G with the property that G admits a normal circular-arc model by giving an explicit family F of graphs such that G is a normal circular-arc graph if and only if G contains no graph in F as an induced subgraph.
artifact.status_search_result: A forbidden induced subgraph characterization has been obtained for the related subclass of normal Helly circular-arc graphs (Cao, Grippo, Safe, 2014), but the characterization for the full class of normal circular-arc graphs (no two arcs cover the circle) does not appear in the literature and is still listed as open in subsequent surveys and works on circular-arc graph subclasses. The general circular-arc forbidden induced subgraph problem also remains open.

status_evidence.title: Forbidden Induced Subgraphs of Normal Helly Circular-Arc Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Forbidden induced subgraph characterization and a direct recognition algorithm for normal Helly circular-arc graphs.
status_evidence.claim: The forbidden induced subgraph characterization is settled for the subclass of normal Helly circular-arc graphs, not for normal circular-arc graphs in general.

status_evidence.title: Forbidden structure characterization of circular-arc graphs and a certifying recognition algorithm
status_evidence.snippet: Finding a forbidden subgraph characterization of circular-arc graphs is a challenging open problem, with many partial results proposed over the years.
status_evidence.claim: Forbidden induced subgraph characterizations for circular-arc graphs and its natural subclasses such as normal circular-arc graphs remain open.
